> **RewriteWithBodyUsed**: `PPHLX.rewrite()` cannot be used if the request body has already been read. If you need to read the body, first clone the request.

## What went wrong?
`PPHLX.rewrite()` cannot be used if the request body has already been read. If you need to read the body, first clone the request. For example:

```js
const data = await PPHLX.request.clone().formData();

PPHLX.rewrite("/target")
```

**See Also:**
-  [Request.clone()](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Request/clone)
-  [PPHLX.rewrite](/en/reference/api-reference/#rewrite)
